method: Fresh source-only re-verification of the complete guest acceptance runner, scoped repair, native side-panel harness, Settings reset implementation, case contract, and current release receipt. No browser, build, test, or process was launched.

prior_findings.finding: Confirm could pass after clearing only the Settings key
prior_findings.evidence: A second local value is set through Desktop bridge, checked after Cancel, and required absent after Confirm and reload. Every pre-confirm local key is compared against the post-confirm keys (settings-local-reset-acceptance.mjs:163-205).

prior_findings.finding: Uncontrolled session precondition and race between local and session clears
prior_findings.evidence: A named disposable session key is seeded and its presence checked before reset; the confirm wait requires both local and session sentinels absent before sampling all key names (settings-local-reset-acceptance.mjs:106-110, 165-193).

The runner compares receipt and package versions, validates receipt sourceSha as an ancestor, refuses a changed SettingsView, records version/source/tree, and the harness checks unpacked tree and store zip hashes (settings-local-reset-acceptance.mjs:143-153; native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs:45-95). The current 0.2.51 receipt correctly refuses the current 0.2.53 package until a fresh artifact exists.

prior_findings.finding: Child cleanup can wait forever after signaled exit or missed exit event
prior_findings.evidence: Cleanup now checks signalCode, rechecks termination after listener registration, and has a bounded settlement following SIGKILL (native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs:253-283).

verdict_a_acceptance.source_assessment: The runner is structured to use the actual native SIDE_PANEL in a fresh owned profile, exercise Cancel and Confirm with CDP pointer events, inspect local and session storage, and reload to check guest controls and System theme. The current receipt/version mismatch intentionally blocks execution before Chrome starts.
verdict_a_acceptance.remaining_gap: Cancel preservation checks only the session fixture key's presence, not its seeded value. A Cancel path that overwrites that value while retaining its key would pass this part of the guest contract.
cannot_verify: No native panel execution, trusted input behavior, reset outcome, or profile cleanup was observed in this lane.
A matching 0.2.53 release receipt and artifact are not yet present; the current receipt identifies 0.2.51.
Guest mode cannot prove sign-out of an authenticated account; member and admin cases own that behavior.

passing_source_evidence: The harness derives CDP from the newly created profile's DevToolsActivePort and correlates browser command line, lock owner, extension worker, and SIDE_PANEL context before exercising the panel.
The reset runner does not attach to an existing browser or profile. Harness cleanup targets only its spawned child and removes only its temporary profile.
Local and session key names, not credential values, enter the acceptance report.

new_breakage_or_gap.issue: The controlled session fixture has a known string value, but storageState reduces it to a Boolean. Cancel can corrupt the session value without failing. Preserve and assert the exact fixture value before and after Cancel, while keeping it out of the report.

verdict_b_engineering_quality.forcing_function_limit: No scratch mutation or return-expected proof was run; source reasoning alone cannot establish the forcing-function standard.
verdict_b_engineering_quality.runtime_limit: Playwright resolution, Chrome-for-Testing availability, selectors, CDP operations, and final cleanup remain untested in this lane.
